title: Figure 7. Schematic of Ajax Hypersonic Vehicle Concept (rendering and energy flow)
description: Upper panel is a color cutaway rendering of a delta-wing hypersonic vehicle above a labeled energy-flow schematic showing "Active thermal protection systems," "Magnetoplasmochemical engine," "Kinetic energy of air stream," and "Directional energy transfer systems." Lower panel is a block schematic linking fuel, an "MHD controlled inlet," "MHD accelerator," "Combustion chamber," "Chemical Heat Regeneration System," and "Magneto-Plasma-Chemical Engine (MPCE)." Captioned "Figure 7. Schematic of Ajax Hypersonic Vehicle Concept," noting both pictures were published by A. Kuranov et al.
